test_plan.name: App Launch Test
test_plan.description: Verify that the Flutter food app launches successfully
steps: Verify the main screen loads with gradient background
Check if search bar is visible
test_plan.expected_result: App should launch without errors and display the home screen

test_plan.name: Search Functionality Test
test_plan.description: Test the recipe search feature using TheMealDB API
steps: Enter a recipe name in the search bar (e.g., 'pizza')
Tap the search icon or press enter
test_plan.expected_result: Search should return recipe results with images and details

test_plan.name: Recipe Category Navigation Test
steps: Scroll to the recipe categories section
Verify navigation to search results page
Check if results match the selected category
test_plan.expected_result: Should navigate to search page with category-specific results

test_plan.name: Recipe Detail View Test
test_plan.description: Test opening recipe details in WebView
steps: Verify WebView opens with recipe details
Check if external URL loads correctly
test_plan.expected_result: WebView should open and display recipe details from external source

test_plan.name: UI Responsiveness Test
test_plan.description: Test UI components and layout responsiveness
steps: Check search bar styling and functionality
test_plan.expected_result: UI should be responsive and visually appealing

test_plan.name: Error Handling Test
test_plan.description: Test app behavior with invalid inputs and network issues
steps: Verify app doesn't crash on errors
test_plan.expected_result: App should handle errors gracefully with appropriate messages

test_plan.name: Cross-Platform WebView Test
test_plan.description: Test WebView functionality on different platforms
steps: Verify WebView loads correctly on current platform
test_plan.expected_result: WebView should work correctly on the current platform

test_plan.name: Navigation Flow Test
test_plan.description: Test complete user journey through the app
test_plan.expected_result: Complete navigation flow should work smoothly without issues
